update.note: There are no updates to install. Checking only shows how it would look.

multitasking.snapWindowsDesc: Drag a window to the edge of the screen to fill half of it, or to the top to maximize
multitasking.snapLayoutsDesc: Rest the pointer on the maximize button of a window to pick a layout
multitasking.desktopsDesc: Group your windows on several desktops. Open Task View from the taskbar.

privacy.cameraDesc: Camera and Photos apps use the camera of your device
privacy.microphoneDesc: Apps that record sound use the microphone of your device
privacy.locationDesc: Apps that need to know where you are
privacy.permissionsNote: The browser decides these. Change them in the site settings of the browser.
privacy.clearAllDesc: Browsing history, favorites, recently played, playlists, photo favorites, Notepad session and notes
privacy.clearMessage: This can't be undone. Your files are not touched.

data.notepadSession: Notepad: previous session and unsaved text

clipboard.historyDesc: Save texts, pictures and files that you copy, so you can paste them again later
clipboard.shortcutDesc: Browsers keep the Meta key for themselves, so press Alt+V instead
clipboard.clearDesc: Remove everything from the history, except the items you pinned
clipboard.note: The history lives on this desktop only. It does not see what you copy in other programs of your computer.

display.brightnessDesc: Adjust the brightness of the screen
display.nightLightDesc: Use warmer colors to help block blue light
display.resolutionDesc: The resolution of the screen this browser is running on
display.scaleDesc: The zoom level reported by the browser

sound.volumeDesc: The volume level of the speakers
sound.systemSoundsDesc: Short tones at start-up, shut down, and for notifications
sound.testDesc: Play the notification sound at the current volume

notifications.dndDesc: Notifications go straight to the notification center without showing a banner
notifications.testDesc: See what a notification looks like
notifications.sampleBody: Notifications show up here and are kept above the calendar.

power.unavailable: This browser does not share the battery status
power.saverDesc: Saves energy by turning off animations and transparency effects

storage.note: The disk is kept in this browser's storage (IndexedDB). How much fits depends on the free space on your computer.

about.touchNo: No pen or touch input is available for this display
about.renameMessage: Use up to 15 letters, numbers and hyphens.
about.renameInvalid: A PC name can only contain letters, numbers and hyphens, can't start or end with a hyphen, and can be up to 15 characters long.
about.resetDesc: Remove all files and settings and start again from scratch
about.resetMessage: All files on the disk and all settings will be removed, and the system will restart. This can't be undone.

network.wifiDesc: Connect to the internet over a wireless network

background.personalizeDesc: A picture background applies to the desktop and the lock screen
background.chooseDesc: Pictures stored in your Pictures folder
background.auto: Default picture, follows light or dark mode
background.fit: Choose a fit for your desktop image

colors.modeDesc: Change the colors that appear in the system and in your apps
colors.accentDesc: The color used for buttons, switches and highlights

lockScreen.startup: Show the lock screen at startup
lockScreen.startupDesc: When this is off, the desktop appears right after the system starts
lockScreen.backgroundDesc: The lock screen uses the desktop background
lockScreen.lockNowDesc: Show the lock screen right now

start.recommendedDesc: The files you worked on most recently

taskbar.alignmentDesc: Where Start and the app buttons sit on the taskbar
taskbar.dockDesc: When the dock is in the way (Alt+D brings it up)
taskbar.dockAuto: Hide when a window covers it
taskbar.taskViewDesc: Windows and virtual desktops (Alt+T), in the menu bar
taskbar.widgetsDesc: The widgets board (Alt+Z), in the menu bar

apps.note: Apps live in the /apps folder of the project. Each one is described in apps.json.
apps.uninstallMessage: {name} and its open windows will be closed and removed from Start and the taskbar. You can install it again here at any time.

accounts.displayNameDesc: Shown in Start and on the lock screen

dateTime.seconds: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
dateTime.secondsDesc: The clock in the corner of the taskbar updates every second

language.displayDesc: The system and its apps appear in this language
language.regionalDesc: Dates, times and numbers follow the display language

accessibility.highContrastDesc: Black background, white text and bright yellow accents in the whole system
accessibility.colorFilterDesc: Make the screen easier to read, in black and white or with inverted colors
accessibility.focusDesc: A bold ring shows which control has the keyboard focus
accessibility.animationsDesc: Windows and menus open and close with animations
accessibility.note: Energy saver turns both effects off while it is on. Both effects are also off when your system asks for reduced motion.
accessibility.shortcutsNote: Browsers keep Alt+Tab and most Meta-key shortcuts for themselves, so these are used instead. To switch windows, hold Alt and press Q again to go through them; let go to switch.

shortcut.switch: Switch between windows (add Shift to go backwards)
shortcut.snip: Take a screen snip with the Snipping Tool
shortcut.taskview: Task View: windows and virtual desktops
shortcut.desktops: Previous or next virtual desktop; D adds a new one
shortcut.start: Start menu (press the Meta key on its own, if the browser passes it on)
shortcut.apps: Open, switch to or minimize the app at that place on the taskbar
shortcut.snap: Snap the window to the left or right half
shortcut.maximize: Maximize the window; down restores it, then minimizes it

startup.note: Apps that start with the system run in the background and keep an icon behind the arrow in the taskbar. Turn one off to stop it from starting; you can also end it from the menu of its icon.
startup.empty: No installed app can start with the system.
